contexts.text: All the fountains of the great deep were broken up () = the extreme of temptation as to voluntary things.
At a fountain of waters in the wilderness () = natural truth which has not yet acquired life. A fountain of waters = truth.
At the fountain in the way to Shur () = that this truth was from the things which proceed from scientifics. A fountain = truth.
Fountains () = Knowledges.

Therefore she called the spring () = the state of truth thence... As this truth was not seen in the Rational, but below the Rational, fountain is expressed in the Original Language by a different word from that which is used above, which is the common word for fountain.
The spring to the Living One who seeth me () = truth thus perspicuous.
They are in the very beginnings or springs of things...
A well of water and a fountain = the Word, and also doctrine from the Word, consequently truth itself. Illustrated.
As the Spiritual Church is here treated of, a well is mentioned, and not a fountain.
That a fountain = the Word, also doctrine, and therefore truth. Illustrated.

The fountain of Jacob () = the Word, and the doctrine of truth thence derived... (On account of this signification) when the Lord came to the fountain of Jacob, He spoke with the woman from Samaria, and taught what is signified by a fountain, and by water... As the fountain of Jacob signified the Word; water, truth; and Samaria, the Spiritual Church... the Lord spoke with the woman from Samaria, and taught that the doctrine of faith is from Him, and that when it is from Him, or, what is the same, from His Word, it is a fountain of water springing up into eternal life. DSS 2:2. AE 483:12.

When they were describing the birth of knowledges from what is intellectual, they invented a flying horse, which broke open a fountain with his hoof... At this day... learning is described by a fountain; but scarcely anyone knows that... a fountain = truth.
The Lord is good itself and truth itself, and therefore the fountain.

Behold I stand above at the fountain of waters () = a state of conjunction of truth Divine in the Human. A fountain = truth; here, truth Divine, because the Lord is treated of. The state of conjunction itself is signified by standing above at the fountain.
She came down to the fountain () = truth Divine.

The difference between the signification of a fountain and that of a well (is) that a fountain is mentioned when purer and when higher truth is treated of; and a well, when truth not so pure and when lower truth is treated of; as is the case in this chapter, in which a fountain is now mentioned, and now a well.
Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain () = the animus of the affection of good towards the truth which was to be initiated in truth Divine... The fountain = truth; here, truth Divine.

At the fountain () = their enlightenment from truth Divine... As the Word is truth Divine it is called a fountain... To stand at the fountain here involves the enlightenment of those things which are in the natural man... for where there is truth Divine there is enlightenment.
Beer-lahai-roi, in the Original Language, means the spring to Him that liveth and seeth me.
Earthly things, with which the Word, which is the fountain of all truth, is obstructed.

It is well known that the Word is called a fountain,in fact a fountain of living waters; and the reason it is also called a well is that such is the relative character of the sense of the letter; and because, relatively to the spiritual, the Word is not a fountain, but a well. Illustrated.
There are two things in the human body which are the springs of all its motion... the heart and the lungs. AC 9276:6. DLord 47. DLove 5:2. DWis 6.
The Word is here called a well because it treats of what is natural... but it is called a fountain when it treats of what is rational...
Although they have not Divine truths direct from the Divine fountain, that is, from the Word...
For He is the Fountain and origin of all celestial and spiritual love...
There can be only one Fountain of life, as in nature there is only one fountain of light and heat... AC 5605:end. AC 10774. HH 9. DP 292.
The rivers and the fountains of waters () = intelligence, and wisdom from the Word.

She sat in the door of fountains, which is on the way to Timnath () = what is intermediate to the truths of the Church and to falsities. Fountains = the truths of the Church which are from the Word; for a fountain, in the universal sense, = the Word.
In the fountains upon the way () = that it appeared as truth. Fountains = the truths of the Church.
They said that... Pegasus broke open a fountain there... For they knew... that a fountain meant intelligence. ( = doctrine from which knowledges are derived. WH 4.)
The son of a fruitful one upon a fountain () = fructification from truth from the Word. A fountain = the Word.

The Word is sometimes called a well, and sometimes a fountain; when it is called a well, the Word is signified as to the literal sense, and when a fountain, the Word is signified as to the internal sense.
The fountain () = the doctrine of truth Divine.
Enlightenment by means of truth, and what is pleasant thence, is signified by the twelve fountains of waters (at Elim); for fountains = truths. AC 8368, Explained.
Where were twelve fountains of waters () = that there they had truths in all abundance... Fountains = truths of faith. AE 458:9.
The fountain of the water of life () = the truth and good of faith.
Affection and thought are the springs of all things of man's life...

And shall lead them to living fountains of waters () = and shall lead to conjunction with Himself by means of truths from the Word. (For) the living fountain of waters = the Lord, and also the Word. Illustrated. ( = in Divine truths. AE 483.)
It fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters () = that from this all the truths of the Word were utterly falsified... The fountains of waters = the Word. AE 518.

Adore Him who made... the fountains of waters () = that the Lord alone is to be worshipped, because... from Him alone... are all things belonging to (Heaven and the Church)... The fountains of waters = all truths of the Word which are of service to the Church for doctrine and life. AE 876.

The third Angel poured out his vial into the rivers and the fountains of waters () = the influx into the understanding of the Word with them... The Fountain of waters = the Lord as to the Word, thus the Word of the Lord; and therefore the fountains of waters = the Divine truths thence derived.

I will give to him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life free () = that to those who desire truths from any spiritual use the Lord will give from Himself through the Word all things which conduce to that use... The fountain of the water of life = the Lord and the Word.
(In the middle of the table) there gushed as it were a leaping fountain of nectareous wine...

When they had ascended the hill Parnassus, some guards brought water in crystal cups from a fountain there, and said, This water is from the fountain which, according to the ancient fable, was broken open by the hoof of Pegasus, and was afterwards consecrated to the nine virgins... The attendants said... The guards are instructed to speak thus; but by drinking water from a fountain we understand being instructed concerning truths, and through truths concerning goods, and thereby becoming wise.
In the middle of the garden there was a grassy circus... and in the middle of the circus, on raised ground, there was a little fountain, which, from the strength of its spring, leapt high.
I saw seven women sitting on a bed of roses at a certain fountain, and drinking the water.

I asked, Why did that boy call you Virgins of the fountain? They replied, We are called virgins when we are sitting at this fountain, because we are affections of the Truths of the wisdom of our husbands, and the affection of truth is called a virgin; moreover, a fountain signifies the truth of wisdom... Then one of the seven wove a garland of roses, and sprinkled it with water from the fountain, and placed it on the boy's cap... and said, Receive the delights of intelligence...
When evils spring from their native fountain...
That these are from the Word is signified by the fountain going forth out of the house of Jehovah ().
That they are to be led to truths is signified by I will lead them to fountains of waters in a way of right ().
The fountain of salvation () = spiritual good, because through this there is salvation.
Fountains and deeps going forth from valley and from mountain () = interior and exterior truths from the Word... AE 518:8.
The fountain of Jacob () = Divine truth, and the Word.
A spring () or fountain = the Word, and also doctrine from the Word.
A fountain of waters () = the Word from which come the (Knowledges of truth).
Fountains = the truths of the Word; the fountains sent into the rivers () = intelligence thence derived. 483 7.

A fountain shall go forth out of the house of Jehovah, and shall water the river of Shittim () = that there comes truth of doctrine out of Heaven from the Lord which will enlighten those who are in Knowledges. AE 483:7. AE 518:10.
To set fountains () = to instruct in truths. AE 518:5.
That a fountain, in the supreme sense, means the Lord as to Divine truth, or Divine truth from the Lord, and therefore the Word. Illustrated.
That Divine truth from the Lord is meant by a fountain Illustrated.
The fountain (that Joseph was said to be near, ) means the fountain of Jacob; for the field in which that fountain was, was given to Joseph by his father ().
A fountain = the Word; and fountains, the Divine truths from it. Illustrated.
A fountain and fountains, in the opposite sense, = the doctrine of falsities, and the falsities of doctrine. Illustrated.
It is from the signification of waters, which is truths, that a fountain = the Word, and the doctrine of truth.
By the fountain in Beer () is signified doctrine from the Word; for, in the Original Language, Beer means a fountain.
A spring () = doctrine; and a fountain = the Word.
Fountains in the midst of the valleys (. 18) = intelligence from natural truths.
The fountains of waters = interior Divine truth, such as is the Word in the spiritual sense.
When fountains mean the truths of the Word, rivers mean the intelligence thence derived.
The fountain (on Parnassus) = intelligence and learning.
